correctness.rationale: The primary full text supplies the exact definition, the length-three IPP1/IPP2 iff characterization, and the theorem F(3,5)=7. The embedded verifier enumerates all 855 coordinate partitions of seven labels into at most five blocks, all 140 IPP conditions, all 210 valid coordinate-unordered triples, and the quotient by all 7! word relabelings. It independently checks every enumerated code via descendants, obtains exactly two classes of 105 partition structures, derives 432000 literal maxima, and directly obtains stabilizer order 48 for both classes. The claim is finite and makes no extrapolation beyond q=5, length three, coalition size two.

value.rationale: The q=5 case is a named exact benchmark in the primary length-three IPP theorem, not an arbitrary slice. A complete equality classification explains a structural feature hidden by the published partial-order minimization: besides the displayed type-III optimum there is a qualitatively different nonminimal three-clique binding. The two-class result, exact census, and stabilizers give reusable structure for equivalence testing and small-parameter construction checks rather than merely recomputing the known value seven.
